boundaries.host_validation: 403 invalid_host for any non-loopback Host header on web relay and Go engine
boundaries.origin_and_fetch_site: 403 origin_not_allowed for foreign/null Origin or Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site across static, health, config, and API routes
boundaries.forged_identity_headers: 403 forged_header on /api/* for X-Forwarded-Host, X-Forwarded-User, X-Forwarded-Role, X-Identity-Override, X-Role, X-Case-Scope, X-Provider, X-Auth-User, X-User-Override

optional_private_tls_ingress.default_access_policy: deny all (loopback only until reviewed operator CIDRs configured)
